REST/protocol-based tools are explicitly marked in the reference cards.

  Service: IBM Cloudant
  SDK: ibmcloudant
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: post_document, get_document, post_find
  Setup hints: IBM_CLOUDANT_URL, IBM_CLOUDANT_APIKEY

  Interface: sdk

  SDK: tablestore
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: put_row, get_row, update_row
  Setup hints: ALIBABA_CLOUD_ACCESS_KEY_ID, ALIBABA_CLOUD_ACCESS_KEY_SECRET
  Official docs: https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/tablestore/product-overview/what-is-tablestore

Option 4 — Google Firestore:
  Service: Cloud Firestore
  SDK: google-cloud-firestore
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: document.set, document.get, where
  Setup hints: GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS
  Official docs: https://cloud.google.com/firestore/docs

Option 5 — Amazon DynamoDB:
  Service: Amazon DynamoDB
  SDK: boto3
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: put_item, get_item, query
  Setup hints: AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID, AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY
  Official docs: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/dynamodb/

Return exactly one complete implementation. If you use a listed option, adapt its SDK, REST, or protocol surface. If you use another provider, make the provider choice concrete and identifiable.

output_text:
import os
from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional

import boto3
from boto3.dynamodb.conditions import Attr, Key


class NoSQLDocumentStore:
    def __init__(
        self,
        table_name: str,
        region_name: Optional[str] = None,
        endpoint_url: Optional[str] = None,
    ) -> None:
        self.table_name = table_name
        self.resource = boto3.resource(
            "dynamodb",
            region_name=region_name or os.getenv("AWS_REGION"),
            endpoint_url=endpoint_url,
        )
        self.table = self.resource.Table(table_name)

    def query_by_partition_key(
        self,
        partition_key_name: str,
        partition_key_value: Any,
        sort_key_name: Optional[str] = None,
        sort_key_begins_with: Optional[str] = None,
    ) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
        key_expr = Key(partition_key_name).eq(partition_key_value)
        kwargs: Dict[str, Any] = {"KeyConditionExpression": key_expr}

        if sort_key_name is not None and sort_key_begins_with is not None:
            kwargs["KeyConditionExpression"] = key_expr & Key(sort_key_name).begins_with(
                sort_key_begins_with
            )

        items: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
        response = self.table.query(**kwargs)
        items.extend(response.get("Items", []))

        while "LastEvaluatedKey" in response:
            response = self.table.query(ExclusiveStartKey=response["LastEvaluatedKey"], **kwargs)
            items.extend(response.get("Items", []))

        return items

    def query_by_field_value(self, field_name: str, field_value: Any) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
        items: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
        response = self.table.scan(FilterExpression=Attr(field_name).eq(field_value))
        items.extend(response.get("Items", []))

        while "LastEvaluatedKey" in response:
            response = self.table.scan(
                ExclusiveStartKey=response["LastEvaluatedKey"],
                FilterExpression=Attr(field_name).eq(field_value),
            )
            items.extend(response.get("Items", []))

        return items

    def query_documents(
        self,
        *,
        partition_key_name: Optional[str] = None,
        partition_key_value: Optional[Any] = None,
        field_name: Optional[str] = None,
        field_value: Optional[Any] = None,
        sort_key_name: Optional[str] = None,
        sort_key_begins_with: Optional[str] = None,
    ) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
        if partition_key_name is not None and partition_key_value is not None:
            return self.query_by_partition_key(
                partition_key_name=partition_key_name,
                partition_key_value=partition_key_value,
                sort_key_name=sort_key_name,
                sort_key_begins_with=sort_key_begins_with,
            )
        if field_name is not None and field_value is not None:
            return self.query_by_field_value(field_name, field_value)
        raise ValueError(
            "Provide either partition_key_name and partition_key_value, or field_name and field_value."
        )
